tags.note:1: JOSM has problems showing the sequence of forward/backward ways, when they do not start at a common node. It does not have problems when ending in suche an open way.
tags.note:2: Because both sides of E53 start with such separate roads, this problem is unavoidable. By reverting the whole route it can be seen, that the route ist sorted.
tags.note:3: Links, which somewhere in between of the route and offer just a short connection to another road, are positioned in the relation near to near ways of the main route. They get the role "link"
tags.note:4: It's known that link is not an official role, but it is seen as the only way to handle this short "dead ends" (dead end with respect to the main route).
